# Manual source versions and releases

Run **Bump version** on a branch with the required `patch`, `minor`, or
`major` choice (default `patch`). It validates the selected immutable commit,
creates one source-only direct child as `github-actions[bot]`, and pushes
only that branch. It never builds, tags, releases, or dispatches Build.
The committed executable pre-push guard checks the actual old/new branch
advertisement, including advance, rewind, deletion, and same-result races.

Run **Build** independently using Actions' built-in ref selector. It has no
custom inputs. Every checkout uses `github.sha`, and the selected source
provides the canonical version. There is no default-branch-only restriction.
Both workflows share repository-wide publication concurrency with cancellation
disabled; this is serialization, not a FIFO guarantee.

## Source authority

Intake `a376189760a976cc2dd2a5bb1354ff0a86145658` was API default `master`,
symbolic `origin/HEAD`, and the advertised remote HEAD.
The complete rename-follow Bump history contains the original fallback
header at `f02d8ada9bbea40c016a1789e8e31b7425c4524c` and its superseding
coordinated header at `1d059554a1a7c947dc94988dc888355a1293f2b3`.
The latter explicitly coordinates `MARKETING_VERSION`,
`CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION`, and both plist version keys, despite its body
editing only the selected project key.

The migration does not increment **1.1.5**. Only six stale source
`CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION = 1.1.3` assignments and the actual copied source
`English.lproj/InfoPlist.strings` short/info `1.1.0` tokens are aligned with
the existing authority, 1.1.5. The six project/target configurations retain
their original identities and Development/Deployment/Default names.
Source `Info.plist` requires its short version; its optional build key
remains absent.

The existing production `v1.1.5` tag/release is not changed. Building this
occupied version stops at availability preflight; use a separate source
bump before publishing a new version.

References resolve recursively and remain references. Duplicates, missing
fields, unresolved/cyclic references, noncanonical versions, configuration
drift, and conflicting versions fail before writes. Token-only edits preserve
encoding, BOM, individual line endings (including the CR-only localization),
modes, and unrelated bytes. The tracked destination bundle and its stale
localization are not source authority and are untouched. Native projects,
static libraries, resources, manifest/4D counters, and prebuilt ZIP/DMG
files otherwise remain unchanged.

## Native policy

The original topology is retained: Ubuntu availability/version preflight,
Windows x64 Release MSBuild, then macOS Default universal build, merge,
sign, notarize, staple, and publication. Windows retains the original CMD
MSBuild invocation with v143 and Windows SDK 10.0 overrides. Its exact
vcxproj output is `test/plugins/Compact Encoding Detection.bundle/contents/windows64/Compact Encoding Detection.4DX`;
on Windows this is the same case-insensitive canonical bundle location.
There is no recursive first-match binary search.

macOS retains deployment target 11.0, required exact `arm64` and `x86_64`
architecture tokens (without inventing an extra-slice prohibition), Cocoa,
the existing `a/libced.a` and `a/libjsoncpp.a`, localization, `manifest.json`,
and `constants.xlf` copy phases. Windows retains `lib/windows64/ced.lib`.
There are no Git tree gitlinks or new dependency builds. The native
project's legacy signing phase runs only for Deployment; the existing
workflow uses Default, so no bypass or native-project behavior change is
introduced.

Cleanup deletes only prevalidated generated leaves and exact intermediate
paths. It never removes the whole bundle, lowercase plugins, Default
siblings, QuickLook resource, or unrelated resources. Final validation keeps
generated output bytes while separately checking immutable HEAD, exact
index modes/blobs, hidden flags, raw nongenerated bytes, and all ignored
and untracked paths. Windows alone may ignore a regular file's worktree
executable-bit mismatch; raw hashes and index modes remain exact, and
symlinks, reparse points, and nonregular types are not normalized. Scoped
inherited Git configuration disables checkout newline conversion.

Only exact generated leaves and proven intermediate directories are
allowed. XCBuildData permits only `build.db`, `build.db-wal`, `build.db-shm`,
and descendants of lowercase 32-hex `.xcbuilddata` records.
Every packaged generated leaf must remain nonempty, regular, and nonsymlink
at publication, including executable, signature, metadata, resources, and
Windows binary. The unsigned pre-sign gate is separate. Final validation
also checks built XML/binary plist, compiled/text localization, exact source
resource copies, and exact downloaded/merged Windows bytes.

Developer ID signing, strict signature verification, both notary submissions,
and DMG stapling remain required. Notarization requires exit zero and strict
JSON `status: Accepted`. Original workflows have no automatic branch-push
or pull-request native triggers. Signing/notary credentials are referenced
only in the manual hosted workflow.

## Create-only publication and recovery

Publication requires explicit nonempty `GH_TOKEN`, immutable `GITHUB_SHA`,
and exact API-canonical identity `miyako/4d-plugin-compact-enc-det`.
Draft-inclusive release pages are read until an empty page. Strict JSON,
schema, authentication, and transport checks fail closed. Exact API and
remote Git tag absence is required before native work and after all
signing, notarization, and stapling.

The publisher separately creates `vX.Y.Z` at the selected SHA, verifies it
through API and Git, creates a new public release with a new positive ID,
then uploads exactly `Compact Encoding Detection-X.Y.Z.zip` and
`Compact Encoding Detection-X.Y.Z.dmg` to that ID. GitHub's space-to-dot
asset-name normalization is verified. The original empty release body and
disabled generated-notes policy are preserved.

There is no update, reuse, clobber, deletion, rollback, retry, combined
release-and-assets command, or automatic dispatch. A same-SHA tag creation
race still fails. On failure, manually inspect the reported retained tag,
release ID, and confirmed or possibly uploaded assets. Partial state is
deliberately retained; do not blindly rerun an occupied version. An operator
must choose recovery or bump source and manually build a new version.

## Offline regression suite

Run `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` and
`actionlint .github/workflows/*.yml`. Python needs PyYAML and Windows tests
need PowerShell. Native and credential commands execute only behind closed-PATH
doubles; race tests use disposable real local bare Git repositories. The
original CMD build is statically asserted, not replaced with a CMD adapter.
The suite does not prove hosted toolchains, credentials, or Apple services.
